notes:
A clean eleven-bullet ladder with two soft spots, which is why this is medium rather than high.

First: bullet 5 has you obtain a Lamian Fang Key and NO later bullet ever says where it is spent. Arrapago Reef is gated by an Iron Gate that this key opens -- 'Operation Teatime' documents exactly that -- but this page does not, so nothing is recorded as needing to hold it and the walkthrough is flagged incomplete. The practical consequence is that the key is step 5's evidence and will be consumed somewhere inside the reef, after which the ladder falls back on the session latch until the Bag of gold pieces re-anchors it. That is the honest reading; inventing an Iron Gate step this page never mentions is not.

Second: bullet 2 gives Ekhu Pesshyadha a grid (H-6) but no zone. Bullet 1 is in Aht Urhgan Whitegate and bullet 3 is the first to say 'in Nashmau', so Whitegate is the reading, and that step is marked medium for it.

Bullets 7, 8 and 9 are one ??? clicked twice -- first a cutscene, then the pop -- so they merge into one step the way Divine Might's Blank Target does. Bullet 10 is genuinely two things, a kill and a third click, and only the third click hands over the key item. The Merrow fallback in bullet 5 is a different zone and cannot be a second source on a one-zone step, so it is items_partial plus a note. The 'Maps' section after the walkthrough is an image table, not steps.

Bullet 4 is the one judgement call. Rhea Myuliah does not advance anything -- her own sub-bullet says she lets you 'practice', and bullet 5 then sends you back to Laila for the real thing. She is a rehearsal room, so she is a step but an optional one; a strict ladder would park the mark on her forever.

Bullets 5, 6 and 7 are one step, not three. Bullet 6 is a description of the audience (3 children, 2 young, 2 older) and bullet 7 is 'perform well' -- neither is an entity you go to. notes:
The cleanest OR-branch in the batch and the reason items_alt exists. 'Must be able to equip either Maul (WHM/GEO only) or Replica Maul (all jobs)' is one requirement with two independent satisfactions, so the obtain step carries the Maul in evidence.all and the Replica Maul in evidence.alt, and the Steel Bones step -- the one where you actually have to be wearing it -- carries Maul in items with Replica Maul in items_alt.

Crucially this is NOT a job gate. The Maul's WHM/GEO restriction is an equip restriction on one of the two options, and the other option is open to every job, so jobs stays []. Reading it the other way would lock a level-31 general-purpose quest to two jobs forever. 'Level: 31+' is the only real gate.

Bullet 3 is a dead end the page documents honestly -- 'Nothing will happen' at Bartolomeo. The draft kept it as a mandatory rung on the theory that it unlocks Powhatan's second dialogue option ('Where am I supposed to meet your guest?'), but the page never says that; it says the opposite. A rung the source declares inert is a precondition at best, so it is now optional -- the rung and the flag stay, the mark does not park on him. The quest drops to medium for that uncertainty. All four of bullet 2's purchase routes and both of the Metalworks vendors are advice, not steps.

notes:
Bullet 5 -- 'wait a minute Earth time, DO NOT ZONE OUT' -- is the interesting one. It is a real instruction but not a step: bullets 4 and 6 are both the same campfire, and wedging an unmarkable wait between two steps on one target would split a single marker into three rungs for no gain. The wait lives in the note on the examine that follows it, where the player will actually read it.

The campfire is written 'a Goblin campfire (???)', which is the wiki's way of saying the thing you target is a ???. A ??? never carries a marker, but the two rungs and the (K-9) grid are worth keeping, and the ramp up the hill from the top of (K-10) is the part players actually miss.

The item is recorded as 'Giant Sheep Meat' rather than the page's 'G. Sheep Meat' -- both resolve to the same id, and the guide prefers the long form. Its obtain step keeps South Gustaberg because that is the only place the page names and it is where the next step is anyway; the Auction House route cannot be expressed, hence items_partial.

Offa is the page's own '(Optional)' -- he explains how the sausage is made and gives nothing. Repeatable, and the header lists both the meat and the sausage as Item Reqs, which is why a player who simply buys a Galkan Sausage will land straight on the last rung; that is right, not a bug.
